slides.texte_overlay:
Weird Habits That Make
People Trust You Instantly

1. Admit a small mistake early

• People trust someone
who isn't pretending
to be perfect.

2. Say "I don't know" out loud

• Then they believe you
when you say you do.

3. Give credit in front of others

• Praise in public.
People trust the man who
doesn't steal the win.

4. Keep your hands visible
when you talk

• Open hands tend to read
as more honest than
hidden ones.

5. Ask for advice,
not for favours

• People warm up to someone
who values their opinion.

6. Always have one interesting
thing to say

• Learn one random fact a day.
Curious people are
easier to talk to.
slides.texte_sophia:

One story from history,
